the development and implementation of a Bioconductor tool that allows the user to perform pathway-based gene set analyses in an easy and flexible way, by providing uniform access to four major pathway databases, and by allowing to consider protein complexes, gene familes, and sensibly removing the effect of chemical compounds.

the development of a novel R/Bioconoductor package, named graphite, able to gather and to convert the information contained in the four major pathway database (KEGG, Reactome, BioCarta and PID) into gene-gene networks.
